motive.en: Second, Shimomura came in after Imazu, before that someone came in, he should see Ran because she uses the rear entrance, the culprit says that it was missed so he didn't see her. Also, the culprit was the one who swinged the body, so that they would think that he committed suicide. He broke the wood so that they would think that it breaks because of Mayama's weight. The pants was sliced off because of the broken wood. The suspects were Hirai, Imazu and Shimomura, Hirai was out of the suspect, it is because they go with Kogoro, Ran, and Conan together in the cave.

resolution.zhHans: 第一，在 Imazu 进来的时候，天狗的声音传了出来。第二，Shimomura 在 Imazu 之后进来，在那之前有人进来，他本应该看到兰，因为她走的是后门，犯人说漏掉了所以没看到她。另外，犯人就是摆动尸体的那个人，好让他们以为他是上吊自杀。那处开放的洞穴正是 Shimomura、小五郎、兰和柯南碰面的地方。犯人利用了这个便利。犯案之后，他利用那处开放的洞穴逃了出去。并在兰回到宾馆之后进入洞穴。他把木头弄断，好让他们以为木头是因为 Mayama 的体重而断裂。凶器在某个人的包里被发现。他在实施这个把戏之前勒死了对方，并用那些石头攀爬上去。之前洞穴并没有开放，所以他可以在 Hirai、小五郎、兰和柯南进来之前杀掉 Mayama。裤子是因为断裂的木头而被割开的。之前，柯南认为尸体会随便掉下来，身上会有很多伤口，但尸体是笔直落地的。
resolution.en: First, while Imazu came in, the voice of the tengu hears out. Second, Shimomura came in after Imazu, before that someone came in, he should see Ran because she uses the rear entrance, the culprit says that it was missed so he didn't see her. Also, the culprit was the one who swinged the body, so that they would think that he committed suicide. The open cave was Shimomura, Kogoro, Ran and Conan met. The culprit used this advantage. After he committed the crime, he used the open cave to get out. And entered the cave after Ran goes back into the guest house. He broke the wood so that they would think that it breaks because of Mayama's weight. The weapon was found in someone's bag. He strangled him before doing this trick, and used those rock to climb. Before, it was not open, so he could kill Mayama before Hirai, Kogoro, Ran, and Conan come in. The pants was sliced off because of the broken wood. Before, Conan thinks that the body would fall carelessly, the body would have many wounds, but the fall was straight to the ground.
